strings.lose: Not quite. Tap to try again
strings.fainted: You fainted. Mam would be raging. Back on your feet...
strings.noAmmo: Out of water balloons. Find a tap!
strings.huntFail: Out of time. Talk to the kids to try again!
strings.bagEmpty: Your pockets are empty. Apart from fluff.
strings.rideHint: You'd need to be on the bike 🚲

swing.title: Aoife's Swing Contest
swing.help: Tap when the swing is at the very top. 3 in a row!

keepy.title: Big Mick's Keepy-uppies
keepy.help: Tap the ball to keep it up. Reach 10!

putt.title: Crazy Golf: Hole 9
putt.help: Drag back from the ball to aim, release to putt. Sink it in 3.

hunt.title: Starfish hunt
hunt.help: Grab all 6 starfish before the time runs out!

coin.name: Coins
coin.desc: Spending money. Mam left it on the counter.

balloon_pack.name: Pack of balloons
balloon_pack.desc: Fifty balloons, assorted colours. Empty. For now.

balloons.name: Water balloons
balloons.desc: Tap 🎈 to throw. Refill at any outdoor tap.

walkie_broken.name: Broken walkie-talkie
walkie_broken.desc: It crackles. Batteries are leaking. Someone on channel 4 keeps saying 'over'.

batteries.name: Batteries
batteries.desc: Two double-As, slightly warm from Deco's pocket.

walkie.name: Walkie-talkie
walkie.desc: Hear whispers nobody else can. Tap 📻 for a hint.

trainers.name: Trainers
trainers.desc: Proper grippy soles. Climb tall gates.

peg_bag.name: Peg bag
peg_bag.desc: Mrs Kehoe's. Shaped like a dress. Full of pegs.

sausage.name: Burnt sausage
sausage.desc: Black on one side. A dog would love it.

wheels.name: Pram wheels
wheels.desc: Four squeaky wheels off a 1970s pram.

skateboard.name: Skateboard
skateboard.desc: Tap 🛹 to dash: zip under barriers and bowl over baddies.

bike.name: Bike
bike.desc: Big Mick's old BMX. Tap 🚲. Fast, and fine on cattle grids.

torch.name: Torch
torch.desc: Lights dark rooms. Dust and eyes hate it.

photo.name: Photo album
photo.desc: 'Tara Glen, Summer 1987'. Damp at the corners.

key_lifeguard.name: Lifeguard hut key
key_lifeguard.desc: Opens the beach gate padlock too, apparently.

shell.name: Shells
shell.desc: Three on a string makes a necklace (+1 heart).

flag_tg.name: The Tara Glen flag
flag_tg.desc: Faded green and gold. Smells of gull.

recipes.text: You fill the balloons. SPLOSH. You are now dangerous.
Wheels on the deck. It rolls! Mostly straight.
Fresh batteries. The walkie hisses into life...
A shell necklace! You feel tougher. (+1 heart)

text: A note from Mam, on the table:
'Gone to the clubhouse for the quiz. Dinner's in the microwave. Don't use the microwave.'
'Stay in the mobile. Do NOT go near 131. Love, Mam. PS The bucket's in the bathroom if you're sick on the Tayto again.'
Out the window: the Top Field, washing on every line, a kid sprinting past with a bucket on his head.
Something about the park feels... off. A peg bag flies past. Then a sock. Then nothing.
Your old walkie-talkie, up in the loft. It crackles:
'...kkhh... manhunt is NOT over... repeat, NOT over... the dust is moving... over.'
Then nothing. The batteries are crusty.
An outdoor tap. You fill up every balloon you've got.
You refill your balloons at the pitch tap.
entities.locked: A tap. Somebody's left a hurley beside it.

text: Clubhouse tap. Balloons topped up.
The beach shower. Freezing. Balloons filled.
Trainers! Proper grippy ones. You could climb a gate in these.

stats.name: The Big Dust Bunny
stats.bark: The Big Dust Bunny rises from under the bed. It is mostly hair.

text: A rusty old pram behind 210. You prise off the wheels. Sorry, pram.
A golf ball, warm and slightly chewed. Biscuit was guarding it.
A golf ball in the rough. SULLY is written on it in marker.
A clipboard: 'GOLF BALLS. Monday: 212. Tuesday: 211. Wednesday: 209.'
'Thursday: I KNOW IT'S YOU, SANDY ACRES.'
LOST PROPERTY box: one shoe (left), forty-three cigarette lighters, a set of false teeth, a medal for 'Mr Tara Glen 1979'.
A sign: 'Older items moved to the cellar.'
The trophy cabinet. 'Under-12 Manhunt Champion: 1994 - NOT AWARDED (winner never found).'

entities.locked: Stairs down to the cellar. Pitch black. You can hear something blinking.

text: Under a pile of bunting: a photo album. 'Tara Glen, Summer 1987'. A man with a fishing rod, laughing.
You cast Grandad's rod over the ditch... and hook the lifeguard's key off the whitethorn. First catch!
entities.locked: A key dangles off a whitethorn branch, out over the ditch. Way out of reach.

text: Lifeguard log: '11:00 calm. 13:00 gull took a child's chips. 15:00 gull took a child's flag. 15:05 gull took my sandwich. Gull is winning.'
Big Gerry drops the flag and flaps off to Sandy Acres in disgrace.

stats.name: Big Gerry
stats.bark: BIG GERRY: SKRAAAAA! (He has the Tara Glen flag in his beak.)

text: You climb to the top of the climbing frame. The whole park is orange.
Lamps coming on, one road at a time. The sea's gone out further than you've ever seen it.
A bench with a little brass plaque:
'TOM BREDA 1931-2009. He loved this view. He caught nothing.'
From the dunes you can see all of Tara Glen behind you, and Sandy Acres way down the strand.
Theirs has a slide. Ours has the Rock. Ours is better.
'...Deco fancies Shauna... over... Deco stop saying over... over.'
A page from a quiz: 'Q7. Which county is the Model County? (If you get this wrong, leave Wexford.)'

entities.name: Senan
text: Senan: I was sure the bin was the best spot. It was not.
A bingo card. Every number is crossed off. Someone was robbed.

entities.name: Rory
text: Rory: I'm not hiding, I'm doing a nature survey. ...Okay I'm hiding.
A note on a lollipop stick: 'I hid here in 1994. Nobody found me. - D.'
A little sign stuck in the grass: 'Here lies Goldie the goldfish. Won at Courtown. Lost at Tara Glen.'
A note: 'If found, this sock belongs to the Kehoes. If found again, it's a different sock.'

entities.name: Niamh
text: Niamh: SHHH. Oh you're IT. Grand, I'm bored anyway.
A flyer: 'TONY'S ICES. Since 1979. Ask about our 99s. Do not ask about the van's NCT.'

entities.name: Saoirse
text: Saoirse: How did you see me?! I'm basically invisible.
A page of a diary: 'Day 4. It rained. Day 5. It rained. Day 6. Sunny for an hour. Got burnt. Best holiday ever.'
A postcard: 'Dear Sandy Acres, our park is better. Love, Tara Glen.'
Someone has written underneath: 'NO IT'S NOT'.
'...Father Murphy has the quiz answers written on his hand... over...'
'...Tony's van hasn't passed an NCT since 1999... over...'

entities.name: Clodagh
text: Clodagh: I was hiding from my brother, not manhunt. But fine.
'...there's a crab in the beach shower... over...'

entities.name: The twins
text: Twin: There's only one of me here. The other one's... also here. Hi.
'...the Sandy Acres crowd stole our flag last year too... over...'

entities.name: Dara
text: Dara: I've a leaf in my mouth. Camouflage.
A list: 'MANHUNT RULES. 1. Base is the clubhouse bin. 2. No hiding in the sea. 3. No hiding in your own mobile, KEVIN.'
A receipt from the clubhouse: '14 x Club Orange, 9 x Tayto, 1 x Babycham (Father Murphy)'.
'...Mr Doyle's boat has a sofa in it... over...'

entities.name: Ellie
text: Ellie: FOUND? Ugh. I had snacks and everything.
A notice: 'LOST: one wellington boot, child's, left foot, green. Reward: the other wellington boot.'
'...Nana Breda used to be the fastest manhunter in the park... over...'

entities.name: Oisín
text: Oisín: Fair play. Nobody's found me in two summers.

entities.name: Fiadh
text: Fiadh: You win this time. Next summer, I'm hiding in the sea.
'...Big Gerry took Mrs Kehoe's ham sandwich right out of her hand... over...'

entities.name: Big Jack
text: Big Jack: Don't tell Small Jack where I am. ...Oh. You're IT.

entities.name: Cillian
text: Cillian: I fell asleep. Is it still Tuesday?

lines: Wayne: I know everything that happens in Tara Glen. EVERYTHING.
Want a hint? I charge nothing. I'm a giver.

reply: Manhunt's been going since lunch. Half the park's still hiding.
And there's... dust. Moving dust. In the mobiles. Not normal dust.

lines: Ciarán: You found EVERYONE? Even my brother?!
By the ancient rules of Tara Glen, you are Manhunt Champion. FOREVER.
Here, my lucky heart sticker. It's a real heart now. That's how it works.
Ciarán: Six found! You're halfway! Here, my emergency coins.
Ciarán: Mam says we can stay up for the bonfire! On the beach! In the DARK!
Ciarán: Are you IT? You can't be it. You're in the mobile. You're on base.
Everyone's still hiding. My big brother's been hiding since dinner time yesterday.
Find them all and you win manhunt forever. That's the rules.
Find six and I'll give you my emergency coins. Find all twelve and... I'll think of something.
Mrs Kehoe: My peg bag! You went into 131? With the dust? You're braver than my husband.
Here. A sausage off the barbecue. And a bit of string, I'd only lose it.
Mrs Kehoe: Lovely drying day. You can't beat a Wexford breeze.
Mrs Kehoe: A gust took my peg bag clean through the window of 131.
Nobody's been in 131 since the Furlongs went home. It's full of dust bunnies. Big ones.
If you're feeling brave, I'll make it worth your while. I've a barbecue on.
Mr Doyle: Tide's out. Eleven years I've waited for a tide that far out. The boat's nearly ready.
Mr Doyle: Eleven years I've been building her. The Saoirse. Ocean-going.
She's in the garden because the gate is too narrow. A design flaw. Not mine. The gate's.
Tip: the sea goes out a long way at night. Further than you'd think.
Shauna: Is that a Club Orange? For us? You're sound, actually.
Deco, give the child your batteries.
Deco: They're for my torch. ...Fine. Here.
Shauna: We were never here. You never saw us. This den doesn't exist.
Shauna: This is the den. Teenagers only. You're not a teenager.
Deco: Leave them. Here, kid, get us a Club Orange from the van and I'll give you these batteries.
Shauna: The van's down by the pitch. Tony. He does a lovely 99 too.
Deco: I'm not smoking, it's a lollipop. It's a lollipop stick. Leave me alone.
Aoife: Keep the deck. It's got no wheels anyway. The old pram behind 210 has wheels...
Aoife: I'm the swing champion of Playground Row. Three summers running.
Beat me on the swings and you can have my old skateboard deck.
Nana Breda: Is that... where did you find this?
Oh, look at us. Summer 1987. That's my Tom with the fishing rod, and that's me in the hat.
He caught nothing all summer. Not one fish. Said the sea was 'having a think'.
...You keep the rod, love. He'd want it out there, not in my wardrobe.
And take a slice of tart. You've got his look about you. Mischief.
Nana Breda: The sun's going down. Go on to the bonfire. I'll watch from the step.
Nana Breda: Hello, pet. Forty summers I've been in 210.
I lost my photo album years ago. At the clubhouse, I think, in the cellar after a dance.
Silly thing to miss. It's only pictures.
Big Mick: Mind the BMX. The back brake is more of a suggestion.
Big Mick: Ten keepy-uppies and the BMX is yours. I've a moped now. Basically.
It's a moped in my heart.
Tony: Tony's Ices! Since 1979! What'll it be?

reply: Tony: Ice cold. Like my heart. Joking.
Tony: With a flake. I'm not an animal.

lines: Biscuit sniffs the sausage. Biscuit LOVES the sausage.
Biscuit wanders off happy. Something was under him the whole time.
Biscuit rolls over. He is a good boy. The best boy.
A dog called Biscuit (it says on his collar) is lying on something.
He growls in a friendly way. He wants something. He looks at your mouth hopefully.
Sully: Three of my balls! I count them every night, you know. Every night.
Here, take the torch. It's only clutter to me. Mind the cellar under the clubhouse; there's eyes down there.
Sully: Nobody walks on my greens. Nobody.
Sully: Golf balls. Kids keep robbing my golf balls. Three gone this week.
Bring me three and I'll give you something useful. A torch. Is that useful? It's useful.
Tadhg: In you go. The quiz is on. Your mam's winning.
Tadhg: Members and adults only. Unless... you know the word?

reply: Tadhg: ...Fair enough. In you go. Don't tell anyone I'm sixteen.

lines: Tadhg: Members and adults only. There's a quiz on.
Unless you know the word. Which you don't. Because it's secret.
Róisín: Is that a 99? For me? I've been on this chair since ten o'clock.
Here, take the fins. Spare pair. You can wade the shallows now, just don't tell my boss.
Róisín: The gulls have the flag out on the Rock. When the tide's out you could nearly walk it. Nearly.
Róisín: No swimming past the flags. Actually, someone took the flags.
I'd kill for a 99. Tony's van usually comes down at dusk.
Sandy Acres kid: You got it back off Big Gerry?! Fair play. Rematch next summer.
Sandy Acres kid: We're from Sandy Acres. Our park has a SLIDE into a POOL.
Your flag's out on the Rock. Big Gerry took it. He's the biggest gull in Wexford.
Tara Glen kids are scared of gulls. Everyone knows that.
Sandy Acres kid: We have a wave machine. It's broken. But we HAVE one.
Father Murphy: Round six! Wexford sports. What's the nickname of the Wexford hurlers?
...The Model County! Five points to Table Two!
Mam: Is that the Tara Glen flag? Off the Rock? Look at you.
Dad: When I was your age I hid in manhunt for so long they went home without me.
Dad: 1994. Your nana found me at eleven o'clock at night in a wheelie bin.
Mam: He's never been found since, emotionally.
Mam: Come here. Sit with us. Best summer yet, wasn't it?
Mam: There you are! Come sit by the fire. Did someone say the gulls have the flag?
Mam: What are you doing in here? You're supposed to be in the mobile!
...Ah go on, we're winning. Don't tell your father I said that. He thinks it's him.
Dad: Grand fire. I built it. Your mother says she built it. History will decide.
Dad: Shh, this is the music round. I know this one. It's... Daniel O'Donnell. It's always Daniel O'Donnell.

locks.text: A tall gate with a bike lock on it. You'd need proper grip to climb that.
ROAD CLOSED. The pole is too low to duck under and too high to climb. You'd need to zip under it.
A cattle grid. Walk across that and you'll snap an ankle. On wheels, though...
The beach gate. Padlocked. 'KEY HELD BY LIFEGUARD'. Helpful.

doors.locked: Tadhg's arms are folded across the door. 'Members only.'

doors.knock: You hear a kettle click on. Then off. Then on. They're deciding about you.
'Come back after the Angelus.'

say: The walkie crackles: '...right lads, the password for the clubhouse is SPUDS... over.'
'...Deco, you don't say over after every... over.'
You now know the clubhouse password.
The sun slides down behind the clubhouse. Lamps flicker on, one road at a time.
Down on the strand the tide is going out. A long, long way out.
Someone's lighting a bonfire on the beach.

tiers: Mam always says a bucket's for more than being sick in.
Open your bag 🎒 and combine the balloons with the bucket.
🎒 → tap 'Pack of balloons', then 'Bucket of water'. The bucket's in the bathroom.
Mrs Kehoe's peg bag blew somewhere dusty.
Mobile 131 is just south-west of 127. Water balloons pop dust bunnies.
Go into 131. The chest in the back room has trainers.
There's a tall gate east of the big road, south of the long hedge.
The tall gate to Playground Row is at the bottom of the hedge, east side.
Walk into the tall gate with trainers on to climb it.
Aoife on the swings has a deck. Wheels... prams have wheels.
Win the swing game, then look behind Nana Breda's mobile (210).
Combine the deck and the pram wheels in your bag 🎒.
The road down to the pitch is closed. Too low to climb, too high to duck.
Dash 🛹 under the ROAD CLOSED pole on the main road south.
Face the pole and tap 🛹 right in front of it.
Big Mick on the pitch is giving away his BMX.
Do ten keepy-uppies for Big Mick.
Talk to Big Mick in the middle of the pitch.
Your walkie needs batteries. Teenagers always have batteries.
The teens in the woods den want a Club Orange from Tony's van.
Buy a can from Tony at the pitch (2🪙), give it to Shauna in the den north-west of 127, then combine walkie + batteries.
The cattle grid south of the pitch would snap your ankle. On wheels, though...
Ride the bike 🚲 over the cattle grid at the bottom of the pitch.
Hop on the bike and ride straight over it.
Sully loves his golf balls. Three should do it.
One's under Biscuit the dog, one's from crazy golf, one's on the links.
Feed Biscuit the sausage (Mrs Kehoe), win crazy golf, find the ball on the far links, give all 3 to Sully at his shed.
Tadhg only lets in people who know the word. Who'd know the word?
Teenagers can't keep secrets. Especially on walkie-talkies.
Fix the walkie, then tell Tadhg the password.
Nana Breda lost something in the clubhouse cellar.
The cellar stairs are behind the bar. You need light.
With the torch, go through the clubhouse bar to the cellar stairs.
Somebody in Playground Row would love to see that album.
Bring the photo album to Nana Breda at 210.
Talk to Nana Breda with the album.
Something shiny hangs over the ditch by the beach gate.
Use the fishing rod by the ditch next to the beach gate.
Stand by the whitethorn near the beach gate and tap A.
Róisín the lifeguard would kill for a 99.
Tony's van moves down to the beach at dusk. A 99 is 3🪙.
Give Róisín a 99 for her spare fins.
Big Gerry's on the Rock. The tide's out.
Go round the groyne, out the sandbar, and wade the channel with fins.
North Strand → sandbar → the Rock. Balloons and dashes beat Big Gerry.
Take the flag to the bonfire.
Mam and Dad are at the bonfire on the South Strand.
Talk to Mam at the bonfire.
